source_snapshot.procedure: Flash BIOS while the system is power-off/standby, power it on, then verify version in BIOS setup and OS.
source_snapshot.criteria: The flash completes without errors and the correct version appears in BIOS and OS.
source_snapshot.script: Private check_fw_version_by_ipmitool_raw reference covers only version readback. Twenty minutes attended and twenty machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL with BMC chassis power off/status only; it exposes credentials, does not distinguish graceful shutdown/soft-off/AC loss and omits the BIOS flash, power-on and version evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION with vendor-defined standby state, separate supported flash method/image, workload drain, approval, protected BMC control, power-on and recovery.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly sees the service-impacting power step but covers only the prerequisite, not the firmware scenario.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly separates power, flash and power-on approvals and requires the missing vendor flash contract.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Standby must be defined electrically and operationally; BMC-reachable soft-off is not equivalent to AC removal or arbitrary chassis power-off.

original_test_intent: Prove that the approved BIOS-flash method works in the platform-defined host-off/standby state and that the system can then power on with the target version visible in BIOS Setup and OS.
original_method: Bind host/BMC and vendor standby/flash definitions, drain workloads and preserve baseline, approve graceful shutdown or exact power action plus one firmware write and power-on, verify retained BMC recovery, execute only the supported flash, then collect boot/version/health evidence.
manual_activity: Owner approves target, drained workload, exact soft-off/standby definition, image/flash method, power-on and recovery; operator supervises power/flash/boot and BIOS Setup.
required_inputs: Vendor soft-off/standby definition and graceful shutdown policy
Signed image/hash and supported off-state flash method
safety_requirements: Drain users/jobs and use graceful shutdown when required
Do not expose credentials or bypass identity
Verify BMC remains reachable and exact power state
Never remove AC or interrupt flash
No auto-retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Present exact power/write/power-on plan for approval
Perform only approved remotely controllable steps
Collect BIOS Setup and OS/BMC evidence
engineer_actions: Approve service interruption and firmware write
Supervise BIOS Setup and own verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: BMC power-off/status can support one step, but the hard-coded ipmitool command exposes credentials, does not prove the required standby semantics and omits flash, power-on and version checks.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After target/workload and vendor state/method approval, perform the required graceful shutdown or validated soft-off, prove BMC-reachable standby, execute the separately approved firmware write, power on as specified and collect complete version/health evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Off/standby flash, power-on, BIOS/OS checks and 20/20-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat shutdown, standby proof, firmware task and power-on as distinct auditable states with independent approval and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds workload safety and precise power-state semantics without dropping the firmware write.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Covers the complete off-state flash scenario rather than only reaching chassis-off.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: An abrupt power action can lose data; a wrong off-state flash method can brick the board.

project_override_considerations: Project must define the accepted standby state and supported flash interface; no generic chassis command or readback script may substitute for the full scenario.
expected_evidence: Approved standby definition and protected power request/status
Signed image/hash and flash task completion

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria form a coherent off-state flash scenario; the readback script and DeepSeek power-only step are incomplete, not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The scenario is identifiable; standby definition, image/method, approval and recovery are finite prerequisites. Execution stops if the vendor off-state path cannot be established.

review_improvement: Restores the omitted firmware write, power-on and dual-surface version checks while making standby and workload safety explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: Reaching chassis-off is only a prerequisite, not the testcase result. Because the row requires a critical write in a precisely defined standby condition followed by boot/version proof, DeepSeek's power-only automation materially changes to a complete REQUIRES workflow.
